name: LinkedIn

counting.notes: UTF-16 code units; URLs count in full; blank lines consume a full visible line before the '...more' fold.

hashtags.excessBehavior: More than 5 hashtags triggers spam heuristics; semantic NLP indexes body copy directly.
hashtags.notes: Optimal is 0-3 targeted hashtags. Avoid >5 tags.

links.recommendedStrategy: Keep full value native (or PDF carousel). Place links in profile Featured section, newsletter, or add organically after initial dwell velocity — avoid robotic instant first-comment links.
links.notes: Outbound links in main body drop median reach 40-60% due to dwell-time loss. Instant 'link in first comment' bridge behavior is also pattern-matched.

pdfCarousel.label: LinkedIn PDF Carousel Viewer Safe Margin (arrows + slide counter)

oauth.gotcha: Standard apps receive 60-day access tokens with NO programmatic refresh (365-day refresh is Marketing Partner only). Requires proactive browser re-auth reminders before Day 60. Daily Share API quotas (~150 requests/member/day) reset at 00:00 UTC. PDF carousels are the top-performing format (~6.6% engagement); saves are weighted higher than likes, and 'Comment KEYWORD below' funnels are throttled. The first 90-minute window determines distribution velocity.

sources: LinkedIn Marketing & API Schema Docs (altText 4086, 3000 post, 1250 comment, 100MB/300-page Document Carousel)
